messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled release 'canary-v3.2.0' is ready for PROD press at 2026-03-20T17:00:00 PT. Requires deployer role or JIT. Tag: prod-pin. Link to release notes: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/PR-452
alice: I'm on-call and can coordinate the press, but I don't have the deployer role. @ben can you press? We need to pin model-server image to v3.2.0-quant (do NOT use latest) because of the perf fixes.
ben: I can press but my MFA key is acting up today (:sweat_smile:). If MFA fails we need a 30m JIT for one-time deployer access. Can someone from eng-sre approve?
carol: Heads-up: release notes updated with a note about prefix/KV cache changes. Also pin redis schema to schema_v12 to avoid mismatch. PR: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/987
dave: If ben can't get MFA, we can do infra-sudo escalation for 1hr, but that requires signoff from eng-sre-lead per policy. Not ideal during the late change window (ends 18:00 PT).
alice: @eng-sre-lead can you approve a 30m JIT for ben? We'll do 2% canary, 10% after 5m, then full if health looks good. Health check: `curl -fsS https://canary.health/redwood` (expect 200). Audit note: "pin v3.2.0-quant due to latency regression in v3.1.9"
eng-sre-lead: Approving 30m JIT for ben. Please add the audit tag in the deploy UI and paste the PR link. Approval ID: JIT-20260320-01 :thumbsup:
ben: Got it, requesting JIT now. If MFA fails, I'll request the JIT token. Requesting press in 2m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: change window ends at 18:00 PT. Any full-scale press past 17:50 requires an oncall SRE present.
deploy-bot: User ben initiated press at 1778004870. Starting canary rollout (2%). Rolling steps: 2% -> 10% after 5m -> 100% after 15m if green.
alice: Seeing canary logs — a few 502s for /generate around 17:03. Snippet: `Error: kv-cache OOM at step 13827`. Looks like quant memory path still flaky.
dave: Can we pause? If it's kv-cache OOM, we should not continue to 10%. Pause rollout and assess.
ben: Pausing now. Opening rollback vote. Anyone object to immediate rollback to pinned v3.1.9?
carol: I vote rollback. We need to protect customer traffic. We'll capture logs and create issue for quant kernel fix.
eng-sre-lead: Agreed — rollback is safest. Initiate rollback and mark incident. Assign to eng-ml for kernel triage.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by ben at 1778005900. Rolling back traffic to v3.1.9 pinned image.
oncall-bot: Audit note recorded: "Rollback: canary v3.2.0 -> v3.1.9 due to kv-cache OOM on quant path". Incident channel: #incidents-ml.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 1778006400. Traffic restored to v3.1.9. No further action required for prod.
alice: Thanks everyone. We'll put a blocking tag on v3.2.0 until eng-ml resolves the kv-cache regression and we have a quant memory mitigation. I'll update the release notes and the release PR with the rollback details.
ben: Thanks for the quick approvals. I'll follow up with logs and reproduce steps in the issue.
dave: Action items: 1) eng-ml triage (owner: @ml-lead), 2) add canary mem limit guard in deploy pipeline, 3) update runbook with quant rollbacks.
carol: I'll add the runbook updates and open the issue. :white_check_mark:
